title: Open on the view the job needs

do.text: Book and compare times on a day or a week: the time grid shows the free stretches.

dont.text: Don't make people book from a month: its days hide their hours.

do.text: When a colour means something (a status, a track), show a legend that says what.

dont.text: Don't leave colours unexplained: the meaning is lost, and lost entirely to colour-blind readers.
